}

.is-quick-suggestion button {

  ) !important;

}


.big-sky__chat-form-block {
  position: relative;
}
.page .big-sky__chat-form-block .lp-typed {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  left: 40px;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  margin: 0 !important;
  --lp-color-field-value: 102, 102, 102;
  --lp-color-field-highlight: var(--lp-color-field-value);
  color: rgb(var(--lp-color-field-value));
  pointer-events: none;
  width: calc(100% - 50px);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.page .lp-form:focus-within .lp-typed.lp-typed {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Hide .lp-typed when textarea has content (not showing placeholder) */

  opacity: 0;
}

.lp-form textarea::placeholder {
  color: transparent !important;

}

    --lp-line-height-huge-pp: 88px;
    --lp-font-size-large: 32px;
    --lp-font-size-normal: 16px;
  }
}
/* Professional, subtle hover for linked hero card */
.lp-hero-cta {
  --lp-control-opacity-hover: 1;
  --lp-control-opacity-active: 1;
  will-change: transform, box-shadow, filter;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
              box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
              filter 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Lift via shadow only. No vertical movement of the block */
.lp-hero-cta:hover {
  transform: none; /* prevent content shift */
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);
  filter: saturate(1.03);
}

/* Slightly firmer press without nudging position */
.lp-hero-cta:active {
  transform: none; /* keep text stable */
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

/* Keyboard accessibility */
.lp-hero-cta:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #212cff;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Inner illustration motion kept subtle */
.lp-hero-cta .lp-image {
  transform-origin: 50% 50%;
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1),
              filter 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Animate only the illustration; no Y-translate */
.lp-hero-cta:hover .lp-image {
  transform: scale(1.02); /* removed translateY */
  filter: contrast(1.01);
}

/* Respect reduced motion preferences */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lp-nebula {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .lp-tabbed-content .lp-tabbed-content-images .lp-tabbed-content-image,
  .is-hover-white a::before,
  .page .lp-sample-prompt,
  .is-sent-prompt-button button,
  .lp-tld-bar .lp-content:not(.lp-tld-bar .lp-content .lp-content),
  .wpcom-g2-rating-count,
  .wpcom-g2-link,
  .lp-hero-cta,
  .lp-hero-cta .lp-image {
    transition: none !important;
  }
  .wpcom-sticky-cta-pulse {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .lp-hero-cta:hover {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
    filter: none;
  }
}

<style id="wpcom-help-center-launcher-style">/* NOAUTORTL */
/* CSS logical properties handle direction at runtime; no RTL stylesheet needed. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab {
	position: fixed;
	inset-block-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	width: 44px;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0;
	border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 10%, transparent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 10%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
	appearance: none;
	-webkit-appearance: none;
	opacity: 0;
	visibility: hidden;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, opacity 0.2s ease;
	z-index: 200;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-ready] {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:hover {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 16%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 14%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-open] {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 28%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 16%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus {
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
	outline: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab svg {
	display: block;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
	width: auto;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0 16px;
	gap: 8px;
	border-radius: 22px;
}
/* Label-only while the label is visible; the icon returns when it hides (≤600px). */
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
	display: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.2;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Loading feedback for a pre-bootstrap click. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] {
	cursor: progress;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	animation: wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse {
	50% {
		opacity: 0.35;
	}
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab .screen-reader-text {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	margin: -1px;
	padding: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
	border: 0;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
		inset-inline-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	}
	/* Icon-only on small viewports; aria-label keeps the accessible name. */
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
		width: 44px;
		padding: 0;
		border-radius: 50%;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
		display: block;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		display: none;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		transition: none;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		animation: none;
		opacity: 0.5;
	}
}

/* Anchor the desktop help-center modal so it clears our FAB (lift 8px
 * above the FAB top) and aligns with the FAB's trailing edge. `right: auto`
 * cancels the bundle's physical right:50px so the logical inset-inline-end
 * wins in RTL; !important outranks the CSS-in-JS rules wp-components
 * ships with the Card component. */
.help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 52px) !important;
	right: auto !important;
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important;
}

/* Clear the logged-out homepage's bottom-fixed "Code for the People" banner: 73px tall, 62px below 768px. */
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
	inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 89px);
}
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 141px) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 78px);
	}
}
</style>

<script type="text/javascript" id="landpack-google-one-tap-auth">

	(function(window) {
		window.googleOneTapAuth = {

		/**
		 * Initializes the module.
		 *
		 * @param {Object} wpcom The wpcom.js module.
		 */
		init: function( wpcom ) {
			wpcom.add_scripts( [ 'https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client' ] );

			window.addEventListener( 'load', function() {
				window.google.accounts.id.initialize( {
					client_id: window.homepage.google_auth_client_id,
					callback: googleOneTapAuth.handleCredentialResponse,
					prompt_parent_id: 'landpack-google-one-tap-auth-container',
				} );
				window.google.accounts.id.prompt();
			} );
		},

		/**
		 * Handles the credential response from Google One Tap.
		 * This function is called when the user successfully signs in with Google.
		 *
		 * @param {Object} response The response object containing the credential (authentication code).
		 */
		handleCredentialResponse: function( response ) {
			if ( ! response || ! response.credential ) {
				window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_error', {
					error_message: 'No credential received from Google One Tap.'
				} ] );
				return;
			}

			window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_start' ] );

			googleOneTapAuth.redirectToLoginOrSignup( response.credential );
		},

		/**
		 * Redirects the user to the login or signup page based on if they are already registered.
		 *
		 * @param authCode The authentication code received from Google One Tap.
		 */
		redirectToLoginOrSignup: function( authCode ) {
			var authNonce;

			googleOneTapAuth.fetchAuthNonce()
				.then( function( response ) {
					authNonce = response.nonce;

					return googleOneTapAuth.exchangeSocialAuth( authCode, authNonce );
				} )
				.then( function( authData ) {
					var userExists = authData && authData.wpcom_user_id;
					var query = new URLSearchParams( {
						oneTapAuth: true,
						service: 'google',
						code: authCode,
						state: authNonce
					} ).toString();

					if ( userExists ) {
						// If the user is registered, redirect to the login page.
						window.location.href = '/log-in?' + query;
					} else {
						// Otherwise, redirect to the signup page.
						window.location.href = '/setup/onboarding?' + query;
					}
				} ).catch( function( error ) {
					window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_error', {
						error_message: error.message
					} ] );

					// Redirect to the login page and show an error notice.
					window.location.href = '/log-in?error=google_one_tap_auth';
				} );
		},

		/**
		 * Exchanges the social auth code for an authentication token.
		 * This is done to verify the user's identity and obtain an ID token.
		 *
		 * @param {string} authCode The authentication code received from Google One Tap.
		 * @param {string} authNonce The authentication nonce.
		 * @returns {Promise<Object>} A promise that resolves to the authentication data.
		 */
		exchangeSocialAuth: function( authCode, authNonce ) {
			return window.fetch( '/wp-login.php?action=exchange-social-auth-code', {
				method: 'POST',
				body: new URLSearchParams( {
					service: 'google',
					auth_code: authCode,
					state: authNonce,
					client_id: window.homepage.lohp_client_id,
				} )
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				return response.json();
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				if ( ! response.success ) {
					throw new Error( 'Failed to exchange auth code.' );
				}

				return response.data;
			} );
		},

		/**
		 * Fetches an authentication nonce from the WordPress.com API.
		 *
		 * @returns {Promise<Object>} A promise that resolves to the nonce data.
		 */
		fetchAuthNonce: function() {
			return window.fetch( 'https://public-api.wordpress.com/wpcom/v2/generate-authorization-nonce', {
				credentials: 'include'
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				return response.json();
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				if ( ! response.nonce ) {
					throw new Error( 'Failed to fetch the auth nonce.' );
				}

				return response;
			} );
		}
	};

	})(window);
</script>

	/**
 * Help Center launcher, inlined by help-center-launcher.php in wp_footer.
 *
 * Bootstrap-then-reveal: render the FAB hidden, then after window.load fires
 * `requestIdleCallback` (or setTimeout fallback) loads the bundle + deps,
 * mounts the React app hidden, and flips [data-hc-ready] to reveal the FAB.
 * Click is one synchronous `dispatch.showHelpCenter(true)`.
 *
 * With cfg.immediate the FAB is revealed at script eval instead, only a click
 * bootstraps (no scroll, no timer), and a click before the bundle is ready shows [data-hc-loading]
 * and opens the Help Center when bootstrap completes within the watchdog
 * window; after a timeout the next click retries.
 *
 * Config shape (window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg, written by PHP):
 *   { route, stylesheets: [url, ...], scripts: [{ translations?, src?, before?, data?, after? }, ...], immediate? }
 */
( () => {
	const SELECTOR = '.wpcom-help-center-fab';
	const READY_ATTR = 'data-hc-ready';
	const OPEN_ATTR = 'data-hc-open';
	const LOADING_ATTR = 'data-hc-loading';
	const STORE_NAME = 'automattic/help-center';
	const TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_show';
	const TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_close';
	const TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_impression';
	const TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_bootstrap_failed';
	const TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_open_pending';
	const BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS = 10000;
	const BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

	const cfg = window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg;
	if ( ! cfg || ! Array.isArray( cfg.scripts ) ) {
		return;
	}

	const immediate = !! cfg.immediate;
	const route = cfg.route || '/odie';

	const isHelpCenterReady = () =>
		!! ( window.helpCenter && typeof window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter === 'function' );

	let resolveReady;
	const readyPromise = isHelpCenterReady()
		? Promise.resolve()
		: new Promise( ( resolve ) => {

		} );

		}

			s.onload = () => resolve();

		}

		}

		}

		assetsLoad.catch( () => {

		// Script injection stays serial to preserve WP print order around

		}

		if ( ! data || ! data.subscribe || ! data.select ) {
			return;
		}
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown || ! fab ) {
			return;
		}

			}

			// worse than none. Record telemetry so we notice when the
			// upstream Help_Center contract drifts.
			trackBootstrapFailure( err );

			if ( immediate ) {
				clearWatchdog();
				pendingOpen = false;
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}

	// trigger the same deduped start. `immediately` (user-initiated) skips
	// the idle wait.
	let started = false;
	const start = ( immediately ) => {
		if ( started ) {
			return;
		}
		started = true;
		// Needed when the fallback fired first; no-op when scroll won
		// (`once: true` already self-detached).
		window.removeEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll );

			return;
		}
		if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {

		} else {
			setTimeout( bootstrap, 0 );
		}

	const startOnScroll = () => start();

	const scheduleBootstrap = () => {
		// Immediate mode bootstraps on FAB click only: no scroll trigger and no
		// post-load fallback, so nothing downloads unless the visitor asks.
		if ( immediate ) {
			return;
		}
		// Bootstrap on first scroll. The help-center bundle + its deps + CSS are
		// kilobytes of JS/CSS that we don't want in the initial-load budget —
		// Lighthouse audits don't scroll, so deferring here keeps the launcher
		// out of LCP/TBT/unused-JS metrics entirely. The FAB stays hidden
		// (data-hc-ready is set inside bootstrap) until the bundle is mounted.
		// Already-scrolled at script eval (hash navigation, back/forward scroll

		if ( window.scrollY > 0 ) {
			start();
			return;
		}
		window.addEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll, { once: true, passive: true } );

		// post-load delay sits outside the Lighthouse audit window.
		const scheduleFallback = () => setTimeout( start, BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS );
		if ( document.readyState === 'complete' ) {
			scheduleFallback();
		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', scheduleFallback, { once: true } );

	}

	// isn't available yet (e.g. bundle failed to load).

		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.dispatch || ! data.select ) {
			return null;
		}
		const dispatch = data.dispatch( STORE_NAME );
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! dispatch || ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown ) {
			return null;
		}
		// Immediate mode only: skip the navigate when the panel already sits on
		// the target route; the app turns a bare route into a conversation resume.
		const routeAlreadyOnTop = () => {
			try {
				const hist =
					select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory && select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory();
				const top = hist && hist.entries && hist.entries[ hist.index ];
				return !! top && top.pathname === route;
			} catch ( e ) {
				// Fall through to the navigate dispatch.
				return false;
			}
		};
		const willShow = ! select.isHelpCenterShown();
		if ( willShow ) {
			if ( ! immediate || ! routeAlreadyOnTop() ) {
				dispatch.setNavigateToRoute( route );
			}
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( true );
		} else {
			// Plain action, NOT the `setShowHelpCenter` thunk — that thunk
			// *returns* (instead of yielding) the visibility action, so a
			// fire-and-forget dispatch never updates state.
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( false );
		}
		return willShow;
	};

	// Immediate mode: a click arrived before the store existed; open once
	// bootstrap lands and clear the loading state.
	const openIfPending = () => {
		if ( ! pendingOpen ) {
			return;
		}
		pendingOpen = false;
		clearWatchdog();
		if ( fab ) {
			fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
		}
		// Already shown (the app restores persisted open state) — toggling
		// would close it.
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		const select = data && data.select && data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( select && select.isHelpCenterShown && select.isHelpCenterShown() ) {
			return;
		}
		const willShow = toggleHelpCenter();
		if ( willShow ) {
			track( TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
		} else if ( null === willShow ) {
			// Bootstrap resolved without the store; let the next click retry.
			started = false;
			trackBootstrapFailure( 'store-missing' );
		}
	};

	const handleClick = ( clickEvent ) => {
		if ( ! clickEvent.target.closest( SELECTOR ) ) {
			return;
		}
		clickEvent.preventDefault();
		const willShow = toggleHelpCenter();
		if ( willShow !== null ) {
			track( willShow ? TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT : TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
			return;
		}
		if ( immediate ) {
			// Pending opens vs. eventual shows make spinner abandonment
			// measurable; once per loading episode, not per click.
			if ( ! pendingOpen ) {
				track( TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
			}
			pendingOpen = true;
			if ( fab ) {
				fab.setAttribute( LOADING_ATTR, '' );
			}
			startWatchdog();
			start( true );
		}
	};

	document.addEventListener( 'click', handleClick );
} )();

    const API_GEO_ENDPOINT = 'https://public-api.wordpress.com/geo/';
    const FCCA_LINK_SELECTOR = '.lp-footer-stack [data-is-fcca]';

    function fetchGeoData() {
        return fetch( API_GEO_ENDPOINT ).then( res => res.json() );
    }

    function removeLink( selector, condition ) {
        document.querySelectorAll( selector ).forEach( element => {
            const parent = element.parentNode;
            const parentTagName = parent.tagName.toLowerCase();

            if ( condition ) {
                (parentTagName === 'li' ? parent : element).remove();

        });

    /**
     * Checks if the given data pertains to the specified region or country
     * @param {string} key - The key to check in the data
     * @param {string} name - The region or country name to check for

     * @returns {boolean} - True if the data pertains to the specified region or country
     */
    function pertainsTo( key, name, data ) {
        if ( data && data[ key ] && name ) {
            return data[ key ].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase();
        }

        return false;
    }

    fetchGeoData().then(data => {
        const isFCCA = pertainsTo( 'country_long', 'germany', data );

<div class="lp-block lp-content lp-content--text-alignment lp-content--text-alignment-left lp-pb-18" style="flex:1;padding-right:30px">
<h2 id="frequently-asked-questions" class="wp-block-heading has-huge-font-size">Frequently asked questions</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No worries, we get your questions answered.</p>
</div>



<div class="lp-block lp-content" style="flex:1;margin-top:0">
<details data-event-name="faq-import-content" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong>Can I install plugins on any paid WordPress.com plan?</strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Plugin installation is available on every paid WordPress.com plan — Personal, Premium, Business, and Commerce. You get access to over 50,000 plugins starting with the Personal plan at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years). You do not need to be on the Business or Commerce plan to install plugins.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-switch-plan" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong>What is the most affordable WordPress.com plan that includes plugins?</strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Personal plan, starting at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years), includes full plugin access. You can install any of the 50,000+ plugins on this plan. You do not need a higher-tier plan to use plugins on WordPress.com.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-switch-plan" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong><strong>What’s included in every WordPress.com paid plan?</strong></strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Every paid WordPress.com plan starts at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years) and includes plugin installation, a free domain for the first year, ad-free browsing for visitors, unlimited pages and users, malware protection, and free support— all fully managed with no separate hosting bill.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-switch-plan" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong>How much does WordPress.com cost per month?</strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">WordPress.com plans start at $2.75/month when billed every 3 years, or $4/month billed annually. All paid plans include a free domain for the first year, plugin installation, ad-free browsing for your visitors, and global CDN hosting. There is also a free plan with no expiration date if you want to get started without a credit card.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-switch-plan" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>Does WordPress.com include web hosting?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Every WordPress.com plan, including the free plan, comes with hosting included. You do not need to purchase hosting separately. All plans include a global CDN, SSL, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and managed WordPress updates.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-domains" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>Do WordPress.com plans include a free domain?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. All annual and multi-year paid plans include a free custom domain for the first year. That covers popular extensions like .com, .net, and .org, among many others. Monthly plans do not include a free domain. If you already own a domain, you can connect it to your WordPress.com site or transfer it to us for easier management. The free plan uses a WordPress.com subdomain (yoursite.wordpress.com) and does not include a custom domain.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-hosting" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>What is included in the free WordPress.com plan?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The free plan gives you a WordPress.com subdomain, 1 GB of storage, unlimited pages and posts, and access to basic stats for the last 7 days. It does not include a custom domain, plugin installation, or ad-free browsing for visitors. Paid plans start at $2.75/month and unlock all of those features.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-plugins" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>What is the difference between WordPress.com and WordPress.org?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">WordPress.com is a fully hosted platform — hosting, security, backups, and updates are all managed for you. WordPress.org is open-source software you download and install on your own hosting server, which you pay for and manage separately. On WordPress.com, plugin installation is available on all paid plans starting at $2.75/month. On a self-hosted WordPress.org site, plugins are always available but you are responsible for your own hosting, security, and maintenance.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-make-money" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>Can I migrate my existing website to WordPress.com?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. WordPress.com has a built-in import tool that supports migrations from platforms including Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, Medium, Blogger, and self-hosted WordPress.org sites. For more hands-on help, WordPress.com’s Website Design Services team can also assist with your move.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-another-language" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong>What is the difference between the Business and Commerce plans?</strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Both plans include developer tools like SFTP/SSH, WP-CLI, Git commands, and GitHub Deployments, plus priority 24/7 support, 50 GB storage, and all premium themes. The Commerce plan adds a fully integrated WooCommerce experience with built-in ecommerce extensions: unlimited products, abandoned cart emails, dynamic upsells, bulk discounts, inventory management, and support for selling in 60+ countries with 0% transaction fees. The Business plan also has 0% transaction fees for WooCommerce payments but does not include those premium store extensions out of the box.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-email-acount" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong>Can I switch plans after I sign up?</strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Any unused portion of your current subscription is applied as credit toward your new plan.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="faq-refund" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white click-tracking-enable"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong><strong><strong><strong><strong>Does WordPress.com hosting include security and backups?</strong></strong></strong></strong></strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Every WordPress.com plan includes malware detection and removal, a web application firewall, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and automated WordPress core updates — at no extra cost. Real-time backups and one-click restores are available on Business, Commerce, and Enterprise plans.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>
</div>
</div>
</div></section>

Ask me.</span></button>	<style id="wpcom-help-center-launcher-style">/* NOAUTORTL */
/* CSS logical properties handle direction at runtime; no RTL stylesheet needed. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab {
	position: fixed;
	inset-block-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	width: 44px;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0;
	border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 10%, transparent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 10%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
	appearance: none;
	-webkit-appearance: none;
	opacity: 0;
	visibility: hidden;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, opacity 0.2s ease;
	z-index: 200;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-ready] {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:hover {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 16%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 14%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-open] {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 28%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 16%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus {
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
	outline: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab svg {
	display: block;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
	width: auto;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0 16px;
	gap: 8px;
	border-radius: 22px;
}
/* Label-only while the label is visible; the icon returns when it hides (≤600px). */
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
	display: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.2;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Loading feedback for a pre-bootstrap click. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] {
	cursor: progress;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	animation: wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse {
	50% {
		opacity: 0.35;
	}
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab .screen-reader-text {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	margin: -1px;
	padding: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
	border: 0;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
		inset-inline-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	}
	/* Icon-only on small viewports; aria-label keeps the accessible name. */
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
		width: 44px;
		padding: 0;
		border-radius: 50%;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
		display: block;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		display: none;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		transition: none;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		animation: none;
		opacity: 0.5;
	}
}

/* Anchor the desktop help-center modal so it clears our FAB (lift 8px
 * above the FAB top) and aligns with the FAB's trailing edge. `right: auto`
 * cancels the bundle's physical right:50px so the logical inset-inline-end
 * wins in RTL; !important outranks the CSS-in-JS rules wp-components
 * ships with the Card component. */
.help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 52px) !important;
	right: auto !important;
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important;
}

/* Clear the logged-out homepage's bottom-fixed "Code for the People" banner: 73px tall, 62px below 768px. */
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
	inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 89px);
}
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 141px) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 78px);
	}
}
</style>

	/**
 * Help Center launcher, inlined by help-center-launcher.php in wp_footer.
 *
 * Bootstrap-then-reveal: render the FAB hidden, then after window.load fires
 * `requestIdleCallback` (or setTimeout fallback) loads the bundle + deps,
 * mounts the React app hidden, and flips [data-hc-ready] to reveal the FAB.
 * Click is one synchronous `dispatch.showHelpCenter(true)`.
 *
 * With cfg.immediate the FAB is revealed at script eval instead, only a click
 * bootstraps (no scroll, no timer), and a click before the bundle is ready shows [data-hc-loading]
 * and opens the Help Center when bootstrap completes within the watchdog
 * window; after a timeout the next click retries.
 *
 * Config shape (window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg, written by PHP):
 *   { route, stylesheets: [url, ...], scripts: [{ translations?, src?, before?, data?, after? }, ...], immediate? }
 */
( () => {
	const SELECTOR = '.wpcom-help-center-fab';
	const READY_ATTR = 'data-hc-ready';
	const OPEN_ATTR = 'data-hc-open';
	const LOADING_ATTR = 'data-hc-loading';
	const STORE_NAME = 'automattic/help-center';
	const TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_show';
	const TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_close';
	const TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_impression';
	const TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_bootstrap_failed';
	const TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_open_pending';
	const BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS = 10000;
	const BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

	const cfg = window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg;
	if ( ! cfg || ! Array.isArray( cfg.scripts ) ) {
		return;
	}

	const immediate = !! cfg.immediate;
	const route = cfg.route || '/odie';

	const isHelpCenterReady = () =>
		!! ( window.helpCenter && typeof window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter === 'function' );

	let resolveReady;
	const readyPromise = isHelpCenterReady()
		? Promise.resolve()
		: new Promise( ( resolve ) => {
			resolveReady = resolve;
		} );
	if ( resolveReady ) {
		document.addEventListener( 'help-center-ready-to-load', () => resolveReady(), { once: true } );
	}

	const injectInline = ( code ) => {
		if ( ! code ) {
			return;
		}
		const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
		s.appendChild( document.createTextNode( code ) );
		document.head.appendChild( s );
	};

	const injectScript = ( src ) =>
		new Promise( ( resolve, reject ) => {
			const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
			s.src = src;
			s.onload = () => resolve();
			s.onerror = () => reject( new Error( `load failed: ${ src }` ) );
			document.head.appendChild( s );
		} );

	const appendLink = ( href, rel, as ) => {
		const link = document.createElement( 'link' );
		link.rel = rel;
		if ( as ) {
			link.as = as;
		}
		link.href = href;
		document.head.appendChild( link );
	};

	// Memoized so a re-entered bootstrap never injects the script set twice.
	let assetsLoad = null;
	const loadAssets = () => {
		if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
			return Promise.resolve();
		}
		if ( assetsLoad ) {
			return assetsLoad;
		}
		assetsLoad = injectAssets();
		assetsLoad.catch( () => {
			assetsLoad = null;
		} );
		return assetsLoad;
	};

	const injectAssets = () => {
		const stylesheets = cfg.stylesheets || [];

		// Preload first so the actual injection below hits the browser cache.
		// Script injection stays serial to preserve WP print order around
		// inline before/data/after scripts.
		cfg.scripts.forEach( ( entry ) => {
			if ( entry.src ) {
				appendLink( entry.src, 'preload', 'script' );
			}
		} );
		stylesheets.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( href, 'preload', 'style' ) );

		stylesheets.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( href, 'stylesheet' ) );

		return cfg.scripts.reduce(
			( p, entry ) =>
				p
					.then( () => {
						// WP print order: translations → before → data → src → after.
						// setLocaleData must precede the handle's code so __() resolves.
						injectInline( entry.translations );
						injectInline( entry.before );
						injectInline( entry.data );
						if ( entry.src ) {
							const load = injectScript( entry.src );
							return entry.optional ? load.catch( () => {} ) : load;
						}
					} )
					.then( () => injectInline( entry.after ) ),
			Promise.resolve()
		);
	};

	const fab = document.querySelector( SELECTOR );

	// Immediate mode: true while a pre-bootstrap click is waiting on the bundle.
	let pendingOpen = false;

	const section = () => window.location.pathname.replace( /^\/|\/$/g, '' ) || '';

	const track = ( eventName, props ) => {
		try {
			window._tkq = window._tkq || [];
			window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', eventName, props ] );
		} catch ( _e ) {}
	};

	// Once per pageview, no matter how many times the FAB is (re)revealed.
	let impressionTracked = false;
	const trackImpressionOnce = () => {
		if ( impressionTracked ) {
			return;
		}
		impressionTracked = true;
		track( TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
	};

	// Deferred past load + idle so the Tracks pixel stays out of the
	// Lighthouse audit window even when the FAB reveals at script eval.
	const scheduleImpression = () => {
		const idle = () => {
			if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {
				window.requestIdleCallback( trackImpressionOnce, { timeout: 3000 } );
			} else {
				setTimeout( trackImpressionOnce, 0 );
			}
		};
		if ( document.readyState === 'complete' ) {
			idle();
		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', idle, { once: true } );
		}
	};

	const revealFab = () => {
		if ( ! fab ) {
			return;
		}
		// A slow-but-successful load is not a failure; don't count it
		// toward the watchdog's give-up cap.
		watchdogFires = 0;
		fab.setAttribute( READY_ATTR, '' );
		scheduleImpression();
	};

	// `storeSynced` keeps a bootstrap retry from stacking a second subscriber.
	let storeSynced = false;
	const syncFabOpenState = () => {
		if ( storeSynced ) {
			return;
		}
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.subscribe || ! data.select ) {
			return;
		}
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown || ! fab ) {
			return;
		}
		storeSynced = true;
		let last;
		const update = () => {
			const shown = !! select.isHelpCenterShown();
			if ( shown === last ) {
				return;
			}
			last = shown;
			if ( shown ) {
				fab.setAttribute( OPEN_ATTR, '' );
			} else {
				fab.removeAttribute( OPEN_ATTR );
			}
		};
		data.subscribe( update, STORE_NAME );
		update();
	};

	const trackBootstrapFailure = ( err ) =>
		track( TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT, { reason: String( ( err && err.message ) || err ) } );

	// A chunk-load failure means the entry bundle references chunk files that
	// no longer exist (stale ?ver). Re-fetch the entry bundle and stylesheets
	// cache-busted: the current build's chunk map replaces the stale one.
	const retryBootstrap = async () => {
		const bust = ( url ) => url.replace( /([?&])ver=[^&]*/, '$1ver=' + Date.now() );
		( cfg.stylesheets || [] )
			.filter( ( href ) => href.indexOf( '/help-center/' ) !== -1 )
			.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( bust( href ), 'stylesheet' ) );
		const entry = cfg.scripts[ cfg.scripts.length - 1 ];
		await injectScript( bust( entry.src ) );
		if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
			await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
		}
		syncFabOpenState();
		revealFab();
		openIfPending();
	};

	let retried = false;

	// A slow load must not be killed (it still opens late), but a click can't
	// pulse forever either: at the timeout, stop the pulse and let the next
	// click retry; after three timeouts take the FAB down. A load that
	// finishes after a timeout still reveals the FAB — its side effects are
	// idempotent, so late success safely recovers.
	let watchdog = null;
	const clearWatchdog = () => {
		clearTimeout( watchdog );
		watchdog = null;
	};
	let watchdogFires = 0;
	const startWatchdog = () => {
		if ( watchdog ) {
			return;
		}
		watchdog = setTimeout( () => {
			watchdog = null;
			watchdogFires++;
			pendingOpen = false;
			if ( fab ) {
				fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
			}
			if ( watchdogFires >= 3 ) {
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}
				trackBootstrapFailure( 'retry-cap' );
				return;
			}
			started = false;
			trackBootstrapFailure( 'timeout' );
		}, BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS );
	};

	const bootstrap = async () => {
		try {
			await loadAssets();
			await readyPromise;
			if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
				await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
			}
			syncFabOpenState();
			revealFab();
			openIfPending();
		} catch ( err ) {
			// Chunk errors only happen after the entry bundle ran, so the
			// retry can't stall waiting on the ready event.
			if ( ! retried && /Loading (CSS )?chunk/i.test( String( ( err && err.message ) || err ) ) ) {
				retried = true;
				try {
					await retryBootstrap();
					return;
				} catch ( _retryErr ) {} // Report the original failure below.
			}
			// Bootstrap failed → FAB stays hidden. A non-functional FAB is
			// worse than none. Record telemetry so we notice when the
			// upstream Help_Center contract drifts.
			trackBootstrapFailure( err );
			// Immediate mode revealed the FAB early; take it back down.
			if ( immediate ) {
				clearWatchdog();
				pendingOpen = false;
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}
			}
		}
	};

	// Hoisted out of scheduleBootstrap so the immediate-mode click path can
	// trigger the same deduped start. `immediately` (user-initiated) skips
	// the idle wait.
	let started = false;
	const start = ( immediately ) => {
		if ( started ) {
			return;
		}
		started = true;
		// Needed when the fallback fired first; no-op when scroll won
		// (`once: true` already self-detached).
		window.removeEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll );
		if ( immediately ) {
			bootstrap();
			return;
		}
		if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {
			window.requestIdleCallback( bootstrap, { timeout: 3000 } );
		} else {
			setTimeout( bootstrap, 0 );
		}
	};

	// Wrapper keeps the scroll event object out of `immediately`.
	const startOnScroll = () => start();

	const scheduleBootstrap = () => {
		// Immediate mode bootstraps on FAB click only: no scroll trigger and no
		// post-load fallback, so nothing downloads unless the visitor asks.
		if ( immediate ) {
			return;
		}
		// Bootstrap on first scroll. The help-center bundle + its deps + CSS are
		// kilobytes of JS/CSS that we don't want in the initial-load budget —
		// Lighthouse audits don't scroll, so deferring here keeps the launcher
		// out of LCP/TBT/unused-JS metrics entirely. The FAB stays hidden
		// (data-hc-ready is set inside bootstrap) until the bundle is mounted.
		// Already-scrolled at script eval (hash navigation, back/forward scroll
		// restoration) — the scroll event won't fire, so kick off now.
		if ( window.scrollY > 0 ) {
			start();
			return;
		}
		window.addEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll, { once: true, passive: true } );
		// Safety net for short pages and above-the-fold lingerers — the
		// post-load delay sits outside the Lighthouse audit window.
		const scheduleFallback = () => setTimeout( start, BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS );
		if ( document.readyState === 'complete' ) {
			scheduleFallback();
		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', scheduleFallback, { once: true } );
		}
	};

	scheduleBootstrap();

	if ( immediate ) {
		revealFab();
	}

	// Returns true (showing) or false (closing) on success, null if the store
	// isn't available yet (e.g. bundle failed to load).
	const toggleHelpCenter = () => {
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.dispatch || ! data.select ) {
			return null;
		}
		const dispatch = data.dispatch( STORE_NAME );
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! dispatch || ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown ) {
			return null;
		}
		// Immediate mode only: skip the navigate when the panel already sits on
		// the target route; the app turns a bare route into a conversation resume.
		const routeAlreadyOnTop = () => {
			try {
				const hist =
					select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory && select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory();
				const top = hist && hist.entries && hist.entries[ hist.index ];
				return !! top && top.pathname === route;
			} catch ( e ) {
				// Fall through to the navigate dispatch.
				return false;
			}
		};
		const willShow = ! select.isHelpCenterShown();
		if ( willShow ) {
			if ( ! immediate || ! routeAlreadyOnTop() ) {
				dispatch.setNavigateToRoute( route );
			}
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( true );
		} else {
			// Plain action, NOT the `setShowHelpCenter` thunk — that thunk
			// *returns* (instead of yielding) the visibility action, so a
			// fire-and-forget dispatch never updates state.
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( false );
		}
		return willShow;
	};

	// Immediate mode: a click arrived before the store existed; open once
	// bootstrap lands and clear the loading state.
	const openIfPending = () => {
		if ( ! pendingOpen ) {
			return;
		}
		pendingOpen = false;
		clearWatchdog();
		if ( fab ) {
			fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
		}
		// Already shown (the app restores persisted open state) — toggling
		// would close it.
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		const select = data && data.select && data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( select && select.isHelpCenterShown && select.isHelpCenterShown() ) {
			return;
		}
		const willShow = toggleHelpCenter();
		if ( willShow ) {
			track( TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
		} else if ( null === willShow ) {
			// Bootstrap resolved without the store; let the next click retry.
			started = false;
			trackBootstrapFailure( 'store-missing' );
		}
	};

	const handleClick = ( clickEvent ) => {
		if ( ! clickEvent.target.closest( SELECTOR ) ) {
			return;
		}
		clickEvent.preventDefault();
		const willShow = toggleHelpCenter();
		if ( willShow !== null ) {
			track( willShow ? TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT : TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
			return;
		}
		if ( immediate ) {
			// Pending opens vs. eventual shows make spinner abandonment
			// measurable; once per loading episode, not per click.
			if ( ! pendingOpen ) {
				track( TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
			}
			pendingOpen = true;
			if ( fab ) {
				fab.setAttribute( LOADING_ATTR, '' );
			}
			startWatchdog();
			start( true );
		}
	};

	document.addEventListener( 'click', handleClick );
} )();

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const API_GEO_ENDPOINT = 'https://public-api.wordpress.com/geo/';
    const FCCA_LINK_SELECTOR = '.lp-footer-stack [data-is-fcca]';

    function fetchGeoData() {
        return fetch( API_GEO_ENDPOINT ).then( res => res.json() );
    }

    function removeLink( selector, condition ) {
        document.querySelectorAll( selector ).forEach( element => {
            const parent = element.parentNode;
            const parentTagName = parent.tagName.toLowerCase();

            if ( condition ) {
                (parentTagName === 'li' ? parent : element).remove();
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the given data pertains to the specified region or country
     * @param {string} key - The key to check in the data
     * @param {string} name - The region or country name to check for
     * @param {object} data - The geolocation data
     * @returns {boolean} - True if the data pertains to the specified region or country
     */
    function pertainsTo( key, name, data ) {
        if ( data && data[ key ] && name ) {
            return data[ key ].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase();
        }

        return false;
    }

    fetchGeoData().then(data => {
        const isFCCA = pertainsTo( 'country_long', 'germany', data );
        removeLink( FCCA_LINK_SELECTOR, ! isFCCA );
    });
});

	( function() {

		 * Establish the farthest away parent from an element matching
		 * a given list of selectors. Selectors can be css classes, IDs,
		 * element types, etc. (e.g. '.my-class', '#my-id', 'div', etc.)
		 */
		const getLastMatchingAncestor = ( element, selectors ) => {
			let foundElement = null;

			while ( element && !foundElement ) {
				for ( const selector of selectors ) {
					if ( element.matches( selector ) ) {
						foundElement = element;
						break;
					}
				}

				element = element.parentElement;
			}

		const getClosestMatchingAncestor = ( element, selectors ) => {

Frequently asked questions No worries, we get your questions answered. Can I install plugins on any paid WordPress.com plan? Yes. Plugin installation is available on every paid WordPress.com plan — Personal, Premium, Business, and Commerce. You get access to over 50,000 plugins starting with the Personal plan at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years). You do not need to be on the Business or Commerce plan to install plugins. What is the most affordable WordPress.com plan that includes plugins? The Personal plan, starting at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years), includes full plugin access. You can install any of the 50,000+ plugins on this plan. You do not need a higher-tier plan to use plugins on WordPress.com. What’s included in every WordPress.com paid plan? Every paid WordPress.com plan starts at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years) and includes plugin installation, a free domain for the first year, ad-free browsing for visitors, unlimited pages and users, malware protection, and free support— all fully managed with no separate hosting bill. How much does WordPress.com cost per month? WordPress.com plans start at $2.75/month when billed every 3 years, or $4/month billed annually. All paid plans include a free domain for the first year, plugin installation, ad-free browsing for your visitors, and global CDN hosting. There is also a free plan with no expiration date if you want to get started without a credit card. Does WordPress.com include web hosting? Yes. Every WordPress.com plan, including the free plan, comes with hosting included. You do not need to purchase hosting separately. All plans include a global CDN, SSL, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and managed WordPress updates. Do WordPress.com plans include a free domain? Yes. All annual and multi-year paid plans include a free custom domain for the first year. That covers popular extensions like .com, .net, and .org, among many others. Monthly plans do not include a free domain. If you already own a domain, you can connect it to your WordPress.com site or transfer it to us for easier management. The free plan uses a WordPress.com subdomain (yoursite.wordpress.com) and does not include a custom domain. What is included in the free WordPress.com plan? The free plan gives you a WordPress.com subdomain, 1 GB of storage, unlimited pages and posts, and access to basic stats for the last 7 days. It does not include a custom domain, plugin installation, or ad-free browsing for visitors. Paid plans start at $2.75/month and unlock all of those features. What is the difference between WordPress.com and WordPress.org? WordPress.com is a fully hosted platform — hosting, security, backups, and updates are all managed for you. WordPress.org is open-source software you download and install on your own hosting server, which you pay for and manage separately. On WordPress.com, plugin installation is available on all paid plans starting at $2.75/month. On a self-hosted WordPress.org site, plugins are always available but you are responsible for your own hosting, security, and maintenance. Can I migrate my existing website to WordPress.com? Yes. WordPress.com has a built-in import tool that supports migrations from platforms including Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, Medium, Blogger, and self-hosted WordPress.org sites. For more hands-on help, WordPress.com’s Website Design Services team can also assist with your move. What is the difference between the Business and Commerce plans? Both plans include developer tools like SFTP/SSH, WP-CLI, Git commands, and GitHub Deployments, plus priority 24/7 support, 50 GB storage, and all premium themes. The Commerce plan adds a fully integrated WooCommerce experience with built-in ecommerce extensions: unlimited products, abandoned cart emails, dynamic upsells, bulk discounts, inventory management, and support for selling in 60+ countries with 0% transaction fees. The Business plan also has 0% transaction fees for WooCommerce payments but does not include those premium store extensions out of the box. Can I switch plans after I sign up? Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Any unused portion of your current subscription is applied as credit toward your new plan. Does WordPress.com hosting include security and backups? Every WordPress.com plan includes malware detection and removal, a web application firewall, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and automated WordPress core updates — at no extra cost. Real-time backups and one-click restores are available on Business, Commerce, and Enterprise plans. jsonld_parsed.name: WordPress.com Pricing | Find the Perfect Plan for Your Site WordPress.com
jsonld_parsed.description: How much does WordPress cost? WordPress.com pricing is simple. We bundle hosting, domains, privacy, and security into one low price with plans for anyone.

mainEntity.name: Can I install plugins on any paid WordPress.com plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Plugin installation is available on every paid WordPress.com plan — Personal, Premium, Business, and Commerce. You get access to over 50,000 plugins starting with the Personal plan at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years). You do not need to be on the Business or Commerce plan to install plugins.

mainEntity.name: What is the most affordable WordPress.com plan that includes plugins?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Personal plan, starting at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years), includes full plugin access. You can install any of the 50,000+ plugins on this plan. You do not need a higher-tier plan to use plugins on WordPress.com.

mainEntity.name: What's included in every WordPress.com paid plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every paid WordPress.com plan starts at $2.75/month (billed every 3 years) and includes plugin installation, a free domain for the first year, ad-free browsing for visitors, unlimited pages and users, malware protection, and free support— all fully managed with no separate hosting bill.

mainEntity.name: How much does WordPress.com cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: WordPress.com plans start at $2.75/month when billed every 3 years, or $4/month billed annually. All paid plans include a free domain for the first year, plugin installation, ad-free browsing for your visitors, and global CDN hosting. There is also a free plan with no expiration date if you want to get started without a credit card.

mainEntity.name: Does WordPress.com include web hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every WordPress.com plan, including the free plan, comes with hosting included. You do not need to purchase hosting separately. All plans include a global CDN, SSL, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and managed WordPress updates.

mainEntity.name: Do WordPress.com plans include a free domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All annual and multi-year paid plans include a free custom domain for the first year. That covers popular extensions like .com, .net, and .org, among many others. Monthly plans do not include a free domain. If you already own a domain, you can connect it to your WordPress.com site or transfer it to us for easier management. The free plan uses a WordPress.com subdomain (yoursite.wordpress.com) and does not include a custom domain.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the free WordPress.com plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The free plan gives you a WordPress.com subdomain, 1 GB of storage, unlimited pages and posts, and access to basic stats for the last 7 days. It does not include a custom domain, plugin installation, or ad-free browsing for visitors. Paid plans start at $2.75/month and unlock all of those features.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between WordPress.com and WordPress.org?

acceptedAnswer.text: WordPress.com is a fully hosted platform — hosting, security, backups, and updates are all managed for you. WordPress.org is open-source software you download and install on your own hosting server, which you pay for and manage separately. On WordPress.com, plugin installation is available on all paid plans starting at $2.75/month. On a self-hosted WordPress.org site, plugins are always available but you are responsible for your own hosting, security, and maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate my existing website to WordPress.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WordPress.com has a built-in import tool that supports migrations from platforms including Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, Medium, Blogger, and self-hosted WordPress.org sites. For more hands-on help, WordPress.com's Website Design Services team can also assist with your move.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the Business and Commerce plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both plans include developer tools like SFTP/SSH, WP-CLI, Git commands, and GitHub Deployments, plus priority 24/7 support, 50 GB storage, and all premium themes. The Commerce plan adds a fully integrated WooCommerce experience with built-in ecommerce extensions: unlimited products, abandoned cart emails, dynamic upsells, bulk discounts, inventory management, and support for selling in 60+ countries with 0% transaction fees. The Business plan also has 0% transaction fees for WooCommerce payments but does not include those premium store extensions out of the box.

mainEntity.name: Can I switch plans after I sign up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Any unused portion of your current subscription is applied as credit toward your new plan.

mainEntity.name: Does WordPress.com hosting include security and backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every WordPress.com plan includes malware detection and removal, a web application firewall, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and automated WordPress core updates — at no extra cost. Real-time backups and one-click restores are available on Business, Commerce, and Enterprise plans.

<div class="lp-block lp-content lp-content--text-alignment lp-content--text-alignment-left lp-wrapper lp-wrapper--layout-left-pp">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We’re a hosted version of the open source software, <a href="https://wordpress.org/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">WordPress</a>. Because when you have the freedom to create, express yourself, and earn money online, the impossible becomes business as usual.</p>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-left lp-margin-bottom-1 is-style-heading-body has-normal-p-font-size" id="better-products-for-a-better-web">Better products for a better web.</h4>



<p class="has-text-align-left lp-color-translucent wp-block-paragraph">We’re trying to create a better web. An internet you can feel good about using. A place where people and ideas come together freely and openly.</p>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-left lp-margin-bottom-1 is-style-heading-body has-normal-p-font-size" id="everyone-has-a-voice">Everyone has a voice.</h4>



<p class="has-text-align-left lp-color-translucent wp-block-paragraph">Ideas don’t belong behind high walls. Software and your posts shouldn’t either. We’re here to help you express yourself.</p>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-left lp-margin-bottom-1 is-style-heading-body has-normal-p-font-size" id="real-support-from-real-people">Real support from real people.</h4>



<p class="has-text-align-left lp-color-translucent wp-block-paragraph">Customer service isn’t something we offer. It’s who we are. We call it Happiness—real support delivered by real human beings.</p>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-left lp-margin-bottom-1 is-style-heading-body has-normal-p-font-size" id="freedom-and-ownership">Freedom and ownership.</h4>



<p class="has-text-align-left lp-color-translucent wp-block-paragraph">Whether it’s a blog, store, portfolio, or something entirely different, you have the freedom to create a site that fits you, and own all of your content and data too.</p>

	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 14%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-open] {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 28%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 16%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus {
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
	outline: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab svg {
	display: block;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
	width: auto;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0 16px;
	gap: 8px;
	border-radius: 22px;
}
/* Label-only while the label is visible; the icon returns when it hides (≤600px). */
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
	display: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.2;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Loading feedback for a pre-bootstrap click. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] {
	cursor: progress;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	animation: wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse {
	50% {
		opacity: 0.35;
	}
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab .screen-reader-text {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	margin: -1px;
	padding: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
	border: 0;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
		inset-inline-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	}
	/* Icon-only on small viewports; aria-label keeps the accessible name. */
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
		width: 44px;
		padding: 0;
		border-radius: 50%;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
		display: block;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		display: none;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		transition: none;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		animation: none;
		opacity: 0.5;
	}
}

/* Anchor the desktop help-center modal so it clears our FAB (lift 8px
 * above the FAB top) and aligns with the FAB's trailing edge. `right: auto`
 * cancels the bundle's physical right:50px so the logical inset-inline-end
 * wins in RTL; !important outranks the CSS-in-JS rules wp-components
 * ships with the Card component. */
.help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 52px) !important;
	right: auto !important;
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important;
}

/* Clear the logged-out homepage's bottom-fixed "Code for the People" banner: 73px tall, 62px below 768px. */
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
	inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 89px);
}
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 141px) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 78px);
	}
}

	/**
 * Help Center launcher, inlined by help-center-launcher.php in wp_footer.
 *
 * Bootstrap-then-reveal: render the FAB hidden, then after window.load fires
 * `requestIdleCallback` (or setTimeout fallback) loads the bundle + deps,
 * mounts the React app hidden, and flips [data-hc-ready] to reveal the FAB.
 * Click is one synchronous `dispatch.showHelpCenter(true)`.
 *
 * With cfg.immediate the FAB is revealed at script eval instead, only a click
 * bootstraps (no scroll, no timer), and a click before the bundle is ready shows [data-hc-loading]
 * and opens the Help Center when bootstrap completes within the watchdog
 * window; after a timeout the next click retries.
 *
 * Config shape (window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg, written by PHP):
 *   { route, stylesheets: [url, ...], scripts: [{ translations?, src?, before?, data?, after? }, ...], immediate? }
 */
( () => {
	const SELECTOR = '.wpcom-help-center-fab';
	const READY_ATTR = 'data-hc-ready';
	const OPEN_ATTR = 'data-hc-open';
	const LOADING_ATTR = 'data-hc-loading';
	const STORE_NAME = 'automattic/help-center';
	const TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_show';
	const TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_close';
	const TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_impression';
	const TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_bootstrap_failed';
	const TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_open_pending';
	const BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS = 10000;
	const BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

	const cfg = window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg;
	if ( ! cfg || ! Array.isArray( cfg.scripts ) ) {
		return;
	}

	const immediate = !! cfg.immediate;
	const route = cfg.route || '/odie';

	const isHelpCenterReady = () =>
		!! ( window.helpCenter && typeof window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter === 'function' );

	let resolveReady;
	const readyPromise = isHelpCenterReady()
		? Promise.resolve()
		: new Promise( ( resolve ) => {
			resolveReady = resolve;
		} );
	if ( resolveReady ) {
		document.addEventListener( 'help-center-ready-to-load', () => resolveReady(), { once: true } );
	}

	const injectInline = ( code ) => {
		if ( ! code ) {
			return;
		}
		const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
		s.appendChild( document.createTextNode( code ) );
		document.head.appendChild( s );
	};

	const injectScript = ( src ) =>
		new Promise( ( resolve, reject ) => {
			const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
			s.src = src;
			s.onload = () => resolve();
			s.onerror = () => reject( new Error( `load failed: ${ src }` ) );
			document.head.appendChild( s );
		} );

	const appendLink = ( href, rel, as ) => {
		const link = document.createElement( 'link' );
		link.rel = rel;
		if ( as ) {
			link.as = as;
		}
		link.href = href;
		document.head.appendChild( link );
	};

	// Memoized so a re-entered bootstrap never injects the script set twice.
	let assetsLoad = null;
	const loadAssets = () => {
		if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
			return Promise.resolve();
		}
		if ( assetsLoad ) {
			return assetsLoad;
		}
		assetsLoad = injectAssets();
		assetsLoad.catch( () => {
			assetsLoad = null;
		} );
		return assetsLoad;
	};

	const injectAssets = () => {
		const stylesheets = cfg.stylesheets || [];

		// Preload first so the actual injection below hits the browser cache.
		// Script injection stays serial to preserve WP print order around
		// inline before/data/after scripts.

			if ( entry.src ) {
				appendLink( entry.src, 'preload', 'script' );
			}
		} );

	const trackImpressionOnce = () => {

			return;
		}
		impressionTracked = true;
		track( TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );

			if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {

		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', idle, { once: true } );
		}

		if ( ! fab ) {
			return;
		}

		// toward the watchdog's give-up cap.
		watchdogFires = 0;
		fab.setAttribute( READY_ATTR, '' );
		scheduleImpression();

	let storeSynced = false;
	const syncFabOpenState = () => {
		if ( storeSynced ) {
			return;
		}
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.subscribe || ! data.select ) {
			return;
		}
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown || ! fab ) {
			return;
		}
		storeSynced = true;
		let last;
		const update = () => {
			const shown = !! select.isHelpCenterShown();
			if ( shown === last ) {
				return;
			}
			last = shown;
			if ( shown ) {
				fab.setAttribute( OPEN_ATTR, '' );
			} else {
				fab.removeAttribute( OPEN_ATTR );
			}
		};
		data.subscribe( update, STORE_NAME );
		update();
	};

	const trackBootstrapFailure = ( err ) =>
		track( TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT, { reason: String( ( err && err.message ) || err ) } );

	// A chunk-load failure means the entry bundle references chunk files that
	// no longer exist (stale ?ver). Re-fetch the entry bundle and stylesheets
	// cache-busted: the current build's chunk map replaces the stale one.
	const retryBootstrap = async () => {
		const bust = ( url ) => url.replace( /([?&])ver=[^&]*/, '$1ver=' + Date.now() );
		( cfg.stylesheets || [] )
			.filter( ( href ) => href.indexOf( '/help-center/' ) !== -1 )
			.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( bust( href ), 'stylesheet' ) );
		const entry = cfg.scripts[ cfg.scripts.length - 1 ];
		await injectScript( bust( entry.src ) );
		if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
			await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
		}
		syncFabOpenState();
		revealFab();
		openIfPending();
	};

	let retried = false;

	// A slow load must not be killed (it still opens late), but a click can't
	// pulse forever either: at the timeout, stop the pulse and let the next
	// click retry; after three timeouts take the FAB down. A load that
	// finishes after a timeout still reveals the FAB — its side effects are
	// idempotent, so late success safely recovers.
	let watchdog = null;
	const clearWatchdog = () => {
		clearTimeout( watchdog );
		watchdog = null;
	};
	let watchdogFires = 0;
	const startWatchdog = () => {
		if ( watchdog ) {
			return;
		}
		watchdog = setTimeout( () => {
			watchdog = null;
			watchdogFires++;
			pendingOpen = false;
			if ( fab ) {
				fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
			}
			if ( watchdogFires >= 3 ) {
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}
				trackBootstrapFailure( 'retry-cap' );
				return;
			}
			started = false;
			trackBootstrapFailure( 'timeout' );
		}, BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS );
	};

	const bootstrap = async () => {
		try {
			await loadAssets();
			await readyPromise;
			if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
				await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
			}
			syncFabOpenState();

    const FCCA_LINK_SELECTOR = '.lp-footer-stack [data-is-fcca]';

    function fetchGeoData() {

    function removeLink( selector, condition ) {
        document.querySelectorAll( selector ).forEach( element => {
            const parent = element.parentNode;
            const parentTagName = parent.tagName.toLowerCase();

            if ( condition ) {
                (parentTagName === 'li' ? parent : element).remove();
            }
        });
    }

     * Checks if the given data pertains to the specified region or country
     * @param {string} key - The key to check in the data
     * @param {string} name - The region or country name to check for
     * @param {object} data - The geolocation data
     * @returns {boolean} - True if the data pertains to the specified region or country
     */
    function pertainsTo( key, name, data ) {
        if ( data && data[ key ] && name ) {
            return data[ key ].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase();
        }

        return false;
    }

	<script type="text/javascript">
	// Try to remain compatible with older browsers
	( function() {
		try {
			var cookies = document.cookie.split( ';' );
			// Don't set if already set
			for ( var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++ ) {
				if ( cookies[ i ].trim().indexOf( 'tk_ai=' ) == 0 ) {
					return;
				}
			}

			var randomBytes = [];
			if ( window.crypto && window.crypto.getRandomValues ) {
				randomBytes = new Uint8Array( 18 );
				window.crypto.getRandomValues( randomBytes );
			} else {
				for ( var i = 0; i < 18; i++ ) {
					randomBytes[ i ] = Math.floor( Math.random() * 256 );
				}
			}

			var anonId = btoa( String.fromCharCode.apply( String, randomBytes ) );
			var date = new Date();
			date.setFullYear( date.getFullYear() + 5 );
			document.cookie =
				'tk_ai=' + encodeURIComponent( anonId )
				+ '; domain=.wordpress.com; path=/; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
		} catch ( e ) {
			return;
		}
	} )();

<section class="lp-block lp-section lp-section--name-faq lp-padding-bottom-4 lp-padding-bottom-6@M lp-padding-top-4 lp-padding-top-2@M is-style-text-gray-100-background-white" data-section-name="faq"><div class="lp-section__content">
